column1: # Stage S11 J1 — tools/ticket_engine dissolves into the four ticket crates under tools/tickets:
# ticket_model (model, encoding, store, vocabulary, repository paths, commit subjects),
# ticket_metrics (run receipts and token estimates), ticket_wave_lock (the wave lock) and
# ticket_registry (registry projection, operations, sync, checks, the verbs). The crate roots,
# the duplicate timestamp module and the commit-subject folder README are written or removed by
# hand. Paths name the tree before the moves.
# ticket_model: the typed ticket, its canonical encoding, the corpus store and the vocabulary
# ticket_metrics: the metrics module becomes the crate; its module root becomes the crate root
# ticket_wave_lock: the wave lock module becomes the crate; its module root becomes the crate root
# ticket_registry: the registry projection, operations, sync, checks and the command verbs
# consumers name the crate that now holds each module
# the moved modules name their siblings in the crate that now holds them
